timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Who do you think is the better athlete in the house?
I think we're good at our own sports.
NFL and gymnastics, which is harder actually.
Well, according to Simone Biles, it has been an ongoing debate between her and her husband.
So much so that he has done my workout in the gym and he can barely do it.
But she said that when she went to their NFL workout, she crushed it.
Seems obvious what she's trying to say, doesn't it?
But the argument aside, Simone Biles and Jonathan Owens get along famously.
In fact, their love story is quite unique.
Despite their close encounter during the Texans game in 2019,
the two officially met via the dating app Raya in March 2020.
And it was Biles who made the first move.
Simone recalled,
I saw him and I was like, oh, he's pretty cute.
So I said hi.
And then I saw that he was in the Houston area.
So we started chatting a little bit.
And then we went to hang out a week or two later.
Since they met at the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic,
they were able to spend a lot of time together while they had time off.
As you all know, this is a perk that busy athletes don't typically have with their packed schedules.
Biles told Access Hollywood that the two would alternate going to each other's houses
and their dogs would play while they would hang out.
We kind of had that time to ourselves to see if we like each other.
And it kind of worked.
Biles said,
we kind of were just like magnets.
The sentiment was echoed by her then boyfriend.
We just kind of started hanging out more and more and you start to want to see a person.
I started to want to see her more.
Funnily enough, Owens didn't fail to note.
My dog really loved her.
Obviously, the two knew early in the relationship that they wanted to spend more time with each other,
so they did.
So when they got engaged in 2022, almost two years after they met on the dating app,
people weren't surprised, but they were extremely supportive of the happy couple.
In an Instagram post, Simone said that it was the easiest yes she had to say,
I can't wait to spend forever and ever with you.
You're everything I dreamed of and more."
She wrote,
Jonathan, on the other hand, couldn't help but brag how he woke up that morning,
the day after Valentine's with a fiancée.
In the same post, he thanked a friend for helping him plan the proposal,
which his then-girlfriend had no clue what was coming.
By April 2023, Biles took to her Instagram to share that they had acquired their marriage license.
Almost time to say, I do, she wrote.
A week later, the couple had their courthouse wedding at the Harris County Courthouse.
We had to get married legally here in the US, since our wedding will be a destination wedding.
The gymnast said in an Instagram story.
It was also then that she updated her name on her Instagram and Twitter accounts to include
her new last name, Simone Biles Owens.
She did, however, reveal that she and her husband weren't done celebrating their marriage,
as they had a destination wedding planned which happened in May.
On May 8, the gymnast and seven-time Olympic medalist and NFL safety
said their vows in Cabo Mexico in front of 144 guests.
During the service, the couple tried to keep things as light-hearted as possible.
Jonathan and I just tuned into each other and blocked everyone out.
Simone shared, I fell in love with him all over.
After being pronounced husband and wife, the newlyweds walked down the aisle to the beat of water
and the drums. Wails were jumping out of the water as our ceremony started.
Simone says, whale season is over by the way.
It sprinkled for two minutes after we got married, which is good luck, and we had a full moon.
It was truly the most magical.
It is pretty obvious how specialty event was for her that she had it pinned on her Instagram
feed with the caption, Mr. and Mrs. Owen.
In the post, she showed the highlights of their destination wedding.
In fact, in her first vanity fair cover earlier this year,
she admitted that her wedding was better than her first Olympic win.
I've never had so much fun in my life. She noted,
I was 19 when I won my first Olympics and I was like,
how am I supposed to top this?
My wedding topped it. It was the greatest feeling ever.
Ironically, this happened while she was taking time off from the sport.
It is no secret that Biles stepped away from competing professionally during the 2020
Tokyo Olympics to cater to mental health concerns.
Yes, probably one of the bravest things I've ever done to kind of put myself first and say no
and speak up about it.
At the time, she suffered from what they call the twisties, a mental block that causes gymnast
to lose track of their positions in midair. Since then, she has become an advocate for the
prioritization of mental health.
For them, it's not an injury, but it almost is and it has a
worse effect on you.
Anyhow, her two-year hiatus seemed to have worked wonders for her.
After she announced her comeback shortly after her wedding to Owens and competed in various
competitions, she wrapped up the 2023 season with five medals, four of them gold at the 2023
gymnastics world championships. That does not include the other medals she received and the
move she had named after her the rest of the season. Needless to say, her comeback was strong.
However, her husband received black over the fact that he didn't know about his wife until
months after dating her, which he shared in an interview with the Pivot Podcast.
While he knew about the Olympics and gymnastics, he wasn't aware of Biles in particular.
He talked about how he realized the magnitude of his wife's influence when kids would come
running to her. Until then, he only knew she was a celebrity gymnast.
This did not sit well with some of her fans, but the gymnast had never been bothered by the
anecdote and even criticized fans for going too far. It was then that Owens appreciated Biles'
humility over anything else. They spent a lot of time together throughout the pandemic,
and she was never vocal about her achievements. Their love was based on respect and genuine
attraction over her stardom, and he was proud of that. Once he caught on though, he made up for it.
When Biles competed again in June 2021, he was there to watch his then-girlfriend compete.
In a post, he said, what an amazing experience! First time getting to watch you compete in person
and you didn't disappoint! I'm so proud of you, my little champ! Today, the love and support
between the two remains as strong as ever. In fact, when the NFL star recently signed with the
Chicago Bears, Simone proudly live tweeted about the move. In a series of tweets, she posted a
nice goodbye to the Packer fans who watched Owens play last season, and expressed her excitement
about Chicago, namely the food and the plentiful direct flights to O'Hare International Airport.
She also wrote, so incredibly proud of my husband, the grind never stops. This is just the beginning.
Shortly after that, she celebrated her 27th birthday. In a couple of Instagram stories,
she shared glimpses of her birthday weekend with her husband. As always, her husband penned a sweet
message for her birthday. He wrote, happy birthday to the most beautiful soul, my amazing wife,
my heart, my rock, and my best friend all in one. He also expressed how crazy it is that life
aligned you with the person that you're meant to be with, and that Biles has made him a better man
in so many ways. I can't wait to support you every step along the way. He concluded,
will we actually see him supporting Simone Biles in Paris? Well, we'll see. Do you think this
athlete will also end up competing in Paris? Watch this to find out!
